newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Mahathir returns from holiday next week.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mahathir returns from holiday next week.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad will return to Malaysia next week after a two-month absence, an aide at the premier's office said on Tuesday.
"The PM is scheduled to arrive in Kuala Lumpur on July 22, but we do not know the time yet," she said.
Mahathir started his rest-and-work routine on May 19, leaving his deputy, Anwar Ibrahim, to officially assume the role of acting prime minister for the first time.
The two-month break was the longest Mahathir has been away from Malaysia in his 16 years as prime minister.
Mahathir spent his time travelling mostly in Europe, holidaying and giving public speeches on one of his pet projects, the Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC).
The MSC is a 15-by-50 km (nine-by-30 mile) zone outside Kuala Lumpur where Malaysia hopes to attract investment from high-technology firms.
Asked on Tuesday about the biggest issues he had to face during his two months in the top job, Anwar told reporters: "The media, the press."
